value.rationale: This gives a natural sharp mobility threshold for densely packed independent sets with zero, one and two spare cyclic positions across a two-parameter infinite family, including all antiprisms. In addition to connectivity it gives exact degree, edges and triangles for the first nontrivial mobile regime, which are not encoded by the independence polynomial. It does not rely on a speculative downstream theorem.
